title: How to reset your password
content: To reset your password, go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password.' Enter your registered email address or phone number and you'll receive a reset link within a few minutes. Click the link and choose a new password. If you don't see an email, check your spam folder.

title: How to update billing information
content: To update your billing details, go to Account Settings > Billing. You can update your card number, expiration date, and billing address. Changes take effect immediately for future charges.

title: How to cancel a subscription
content: To cancel your subscription, go to Account Settings > Subscription and click 'Cancel Plan.' Your access will continue until the end of the current billing period, and you won't be charged again.

title: How to troubleshoot login problems
content: If you can't log in, first confirm you're using the correct email address. Try resetting your password. If the issue persists, clear your browser cache or try a different browser. Contact support if you still can't access your account.

title: How to contact technical support
content: You can reach technical support via the in-app chat widget, or by emailing example@company.com. Include your account email and a description of the issue for faster resolution.
